name: Example Payment HSM 9000
description: Illustrative payment HSM, firmware 4.2.0, as shipped.
comment: Illustrative example for the draft HSM Product and HSM Key Hierarchy profiles. The HSM, its vendor and every value are invented. Built by drafts/hsm-product/build.py.

attributes.name: negotiationControl
values: Client certificates and groups are set in the HSM's security settings

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Hybrid ML-KEM key exchange is committed for firmware 5.0; ML-DSA client certificates wait for FIPS 140-3 validation of the new firmware

interfaces.name: Management console and key custodian smart cards

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Key ceremonies need a quorum of custodian smart cards

attributes.name: negotiationControl
values: Set per terminal estate by the acquirer

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: No post-quantum key transport is standardised for TR-34 yet

interfaces.name: Local master key store (inside the tamper-responsive boundary)

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: The local master key never leaves the HSM. It is protected by the tamper-responsive hardware.

interfaces.name: Working key database on the host, under the local master key

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Working keys and zone master keys are kept on the host in X9.143 key blocks, wrapped under the local master key.

references.comment: Illustrative SBOM of the same firmware release.
